## Activity

During July 2022, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 46 captures. This report summarises activity at the site, the quality of the images produced, and the outcome of grading. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing the service delivered during the month and for considering image quality alongside grading outcomes.

## Image quality

There were 3 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 6.5 per cent. This indicates the proportion of the recorded captures that could not be used for grading. The figure is reported alongside the total activity so that image quality can be considered in the context of the site’s monthly workload.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 25 days. This is the midpoint measure for the time between the image being taken and the grading outcome being recorded. Taken together, the activity, image-quality and grading figures provide a concise operational summary for Hill Counties Health Centre for July 2022.
